rev.t: The Obrama Bakery Review: A Slice of Heaven!The Obrama Bakery is truly one of the finest bakeries I've had the pleasure of visiting! The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. …

One of the best patisseries in Banglore. Loved the items that I tried. The shop is by the roadside. The place is not usually crowded. They serve many kinds of desserts. Lemon tarts, mousse cakes, cheesecakes etc. That too both egg and …

We ordered eggless millionaire brownie and dutch truffle cake. The brownie was really really good. The cake was thick and sticky (maybe that’s how it was supposed to be). Both items tasted good. The overall ambience is that of a small cute cafe.
